facts.text: Tickets, please. Hot chocolate for every passenger tonight, and seconds for anyone who asks politely.
facts.why: The Conductor never says this. The film's own words from him are about belief, such as 'sometimes the most real things in the world are the things we can't see'.
facts.fix: Sometimes the most real things in the world are the things we can't see.
